finding: Displayed and copied text share one value; event excludes the value
decision: Use one reactive value and an outcome-only frozen detail object
Adopt its sheet/classes for one native copy button rather than inventing a button family

finding: Accessible label and focus must reach the native control
decision: Apply aria-label to the real button and keep the host out of sequential focus

finding: A tabindex on a focusable wrapper creates duplicate tab stops
decision: Expose no host tabindex and use only tabindex=-1 on the manual selection target

finding: Live-region role/node stability is required before message changes
decision: Render one permanent polite atomic status node per instance
Keep actionable copy fields separate from prose styling

finding: D1/D2/D4/D6/D8 repeat compact copy fields; D2 wraps on 390px
decision: Publish a block box with wrapping value and adjacent/reflowing native action

finding: Shadow components expose tokens and declared parts
decision: Use token-only CSS and documented field/value/control/status parts

finding: JavaScript-dependent behavior has no truthful static form
decision: Omit a static markup module and document the JS boundary

finding: Behavior-bearing elements require surgical red-first coverage
decision: Register applicable ADR-11 behaviors and mutation arms
